per_step.command:
mkdir -p /app/output && echo "# Contract Risk Summary Report

Generated on $(date)

" > /app/output/risk_summary.md && for file in /app/contracts/*; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then echo "## Analysis for: $(basename "$file")
" >> /app/output/risk_summary.md && /usr/local/bin/analyze_contract.sh "$file" >> /app/output/risk_summary.md && echo "
---

" >> /app/output/risk_summary.md; fi; done && echo "Processing complete. Report saved to /app/output/risk_summary.md"
